_meta.description: Configuration for travel planner validation scripts

_enforce_title_case_description: Whether to enforce Title Case formatting for type_base fields (e.g., 'Shopping Mall' instead of 'shopping mall'). Set to false to disable this check.
_meal_hint_ranges_description: Hour ranges [start, end) for each meal slot, used to disambiguate timeline matches when a POI appears multiple times per day.
_travel_segment_required_fields_descript: Fields that must be present and non-empty in every travel_segments[] entry. Validated in plan-validate.py section 3c.
_level_1_fields_description: Fields exposed at load.py --level 1 (day metadata only, no POI details).
_level_2_extra_fields_description: Additional fields exposed at load.py --level 2 (POI titles/keys). Combined with level_1_fields to form the full Level 2 field set.
_agent_poi_key_overrides_description: Overrides for agent POI key lists that cannot be auto-derived from schemas. 'timeline' has two keys (timeline + travel_segments) and is excluded from auto-derivation. All other agents are derived by reading their schema's day_entry properties.
